reason: My architect already does the 3D models and renders and it's baked into their fee, so I'd be paying twice for something I already get. I'm on job sites all day and not looking to add another vendor.
objection: Will it actually match the plans? If it shows my client something we won't build, I'm the one who eats that argument, and I'm paying $500 a round to fix it.
would_change_my_mind: If the free sample of one of my current plans matched the drawings exactly, my clients preferred it to what the architect gave them, and it was cheap enough to use on spec homes where there's no architect render.
